profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer · Payments & Accounts Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 9 years of experience building payment systems, APIs, and full-stack web applications.

Most of my career has been at a SaaS platform where I led a payments-focused team, building a white-label Stripe integration from the ground up — covering merchant onboarding, checkout, payouts, and alternate payment methods including Buy Now Pay Later. I served as the company’s primary Stripe engineering contact and worked directly with the Stripe team on integration decisions.

I’m full-stack across Next.js, React, PHP/Laravel, and Node.js, and have worked across a range of product contexts — payments infrastructure, developer tooling, AI-powered products, and B2B SaaS.
I’m currently open to new opportunities, particularly roles involving payments, platform engineering, or full-stack product work.

contact email - jones.reed.dev@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a payments team to develop a comprehensive white-label Stripe integration, covering merchant onboarding and checkout processes.  
• Served as the primary engineering contact for Stripe, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration.  
• Contributed to the development of authentication migration using Supabase and SSO integrations.  
• Implemented AI-assisted development practices with Claude Code to enhance coding efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack solutions for payments, subscriptions, and platform products at SamCart.  
• Contributed to the integration of Square payment processor, enhancing transaction efficiency.  
• Built a self-service subscription management micro-service to streamline user experience.  
• Created modular onboarding flows to improve customer engagement and retention.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer In Test
positions.description: Built and maintained automated UI regression test suites in C# and Selenium across two products.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Built a Java billing platform consolidating multiple lines of business and developed RESTful micro-services.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a professor on cutting-edge research in semiconductor lasers incorporating Graphene.  
• Focused on wire bonding to apply power to semiconductor devices and enhance connectivity.  
• Assisted in various tasks related to contacting semiconductor materials to metal, contributing to innovative research.
